title: Vehicles finish at configured end depots
description: start_index != end_index; each route ends at its end_index.
expectedResult: 200; status:'Ok' with id; result.code==0; each route ends at its vehicle end_index; all 25 jobs assigned; result.unassigned empty.

title: Delivery load within vehicle capacity
description: Per-route delivery load never exceeds capacity [50].
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; all 25 jobs assigned; result.unassigned empty; no route load exceeds capacity [50].

title: Jobs reference valid location indices
description: All 25 job location_index values resolve within locations.location.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; every job served at its referenced location_index; all 25 assigned.

title: Delivery quantities assigned within capacity
description: Delivery demand distributed across the fleet.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; all 25 jobs assigned; total assigned delivery equals 50; per-route load <= capacity.

title: Large splittable job is split across vehicles
description: A job with delivery far above a single vehicle capacity, can_be_split=true, splits across the fleet.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; job 'big' (delivery 8 > capacity 2) is SPLIT across vehicles; sub-deliveries sum to 8; 'big' NOT in result.unassigned; no route load exceeds capacity [2].

title: Non-splittable oversized job is left unassigned
description: Delivery ~5x capacity with can_be_split=false; the job cannot fit any single vehicle and is unassigned.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; job 'big' (delivery 10 > capacity 2, can_be_split=false) appears in result.unassigned with a capacity reason; the 24 normal jobs remain assigned.

feature: Split Order — max_splits at needed count
title: Split with max_splits exactly equal to splits needed
description: Delivery 5 with capacity 1 needs exactly 5 splits; max_splits=5 (=vehicle count) is the boundary.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; job 'big' is split into exactly 5 parts (one per vehicle); each split delivery <= capacity [1]; sub-deliveries sum to 5.

title: Split honoring a minimum quantity ratio per split
description: can_be_split=true with quant set so each split carries at least the minimum ratio of the job load (single load dimension).
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; job 'big' (delivery 9) split so each part >= quant ratio (0.2*9=1.8) and <= capacity [3]; sub-deliveries sum to 9. (quant single-dimension per doc.)

title: Split job with distinct end depots and capacity limits
description: Combines jobs.split (can_be_split), vehicles.end_index and vehicles.capacity in one scenario.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; 'big' split across vehicles (sub-deliveries sum to 7); each route ends at its end_index; no route exceeds capacity [2]; all jobs assigned.

title: Splittable and normal delivery jobs together
description: A mix of normal delivery jobs and one splittable oversized job all handled in one plan.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; normal jobs assigned within capacity [3]; 'big' split across vehicles (sub-deliveries sum to 9); result.unassigned empty.
